expected_assessment: Valid feature request: join_arranged_lobby_async hard-codes max members, owner migration, access policy, and invite restriction, while PlayFabLobbyJoinConfig only carries member properties; PlayFabLobbyConfig already models the equivalent create-time options.

evidence.why: Arranged-lobby join hard-codes the creation configuration.
PlayFabLobbyConfig already exposes owner migration and invite restriction.

key_facts: Values hard-coded: max member count 8, automatic owner migration, private access, restrict invites false.
Existing PlayFabLobbyConfig could be reused or mirrored.
acceptable_uncertainty: Whether to extend PlayFabLobbyJoinConfig or accept a PlayFabLobbyConfig.
relevant_questions: Which fields must be configurable and default compatibility expectations.
avoid: Classifying as a bug with a crash.
